using Random
using Unicode

export AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer, encode, decode

const SYNASTRY_ORBS = [0.189, 0.172, 0.366, 0.224, 0.096, 0.154, 0.249, -0.12, 0.227, 0.709, -0.138, 0.301, 0.203, 0.943, 0.45, 0.265, 0.156, 0.147]
const CELESTIAL_CHART_1 = [25.925, 19.023, 15.506, 23.544, 26.571, 8.295, 24.611, 1.757, 12.946, 19.794]
const CELESTIAL_CHART_2 = [10.877, 18.723, 29.018, 27.266, 21.858, 1.237, 24.090, 20.250, 6.432, 14.681]

mutable struct AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer
    base_vocab_size::Int
    max_vocab_size::Int
    d_model::Int
    grid_size::Int
    degree::Int
    vocab::Dict{String, Int}
    merges::Dict{Tuple{String, String}, String}
    function AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer(; base_vocab_size::Int=32768, max_vocab_size::Int=65536, d_model::Int=18432, grid_size::Int=8, degree::Int=4)
        if grid_size <= 0 || degree < 0 || degree >= grid_size
            throw(ArgumentError("Invalid spline parameters: grid_size must be > 0 and degree must satisfy 0 <= degree < grid_size"))
        end
        vocab = Dict{String, Int}("UNK" => 0, "PAD" => 1, "BOS" => 2, "EOS" => 3)
        for i in 32:126
            vocab[string(Char(i))] = length(vocab)
        end
        new(base_vocab_size, max_vocab_size, d_model, grid_size, degree, vocab, Dict{Tuple{String, String}, String}())
    end
end

function _lorenz_embedding(id::Float64, index::Float64, d_model::Int)
    sigma = 10.0
    rho = 28.0
    beta = 8.0 / 3.0
    dt = 0.01
    x = id * 0.1
    y = index * 2.0
    z = id * 0.05
    embedding = Vector{Float64}(undef, d_model)
    @inbounds @simd for j in 1:d_model
        dx = sigma * (y - x)
        dy = x * (rho - z) - y
        dz = x * y - beta * z
        x += dx * dt
        y += dy * dt
        z += dz * dt
        embedding[j] = 0.1 * sin(x) + 0.1 * cos(y) + 0.1 * sin(z)
    end
    return embedding
end

function _b_spline_basis(x::Float64, knots::Vector{Float64}, i::Int, k::Int)
    if k == 0
        return ((knots[i] <= x < knots[i+1]) || (x == 1.0 && knots[i+1] == 1.0)) ? 1.0 : 0.0
    end
    term1_denom = knots[i + k] - knots[i]
    term1 = term1_denom == 0.0 ? 0.0 : (x - knots[i]) / term1_denom * _b_spline_basis(x, knots, i, k - 1)
    term2_denom = knots[i + k + 1] - knots[i + 1]
    term2 = term2_denom == 0.0 ? 0.0 : (knots[i + k + 1] - x) / term2_denom * _b_spline_basis(x, knots, i + 1, k - 1)
    return term1 + term2
end

function _make_knots(grid_size::Int, degree::Int)
    return vcat(zeros(Float64, degree), collect(range(0.0, 1.0; length=grid_size - degree + 1)), ones(Float64, degree))
end

function _kan_spline_eval(x::Float64, coeffs::Vector{Float64}, knots::Vector{Float64}, grid_size::Int, degree::Int)
    val = 0.0
    @inbounds @simd for i in 1:grid_size
        val += coeffs[i] * _b_spline_basis(x, knots, i, degree)
    end
    return val
end

function encode(tokenizer::AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer, text::String, birth_chart::Vector{Float64})
    normalized_text = lowercase(replace(text, r"\s+" => " "))
    graphemes_vec = collect(Unicode.graphemes(normalized_text))
    ids = Vector{Int}(undef, length(graphemes_vec))
    @inbounds for i in 1:length(graphemes_vec)
        ids[i] = get(tokenizer.vocab, graphemes_vec[i], 0)
    end
    embeddings = Matrix{Float64}(undef, length(ids), tokenizer.d_model)
    spline_coeffs = rand(tokenizer.grid_size)
    knots = _make_knots(tokenizer.grid_size, tokenizer.degree)
    glen = length(ids)
    bc_len = length(birth_chart)
    @inbounds for i in 1:length(ids)
        tid = ids[i]
        lorenz_vec = _lorenz_embedding(Float64(tid), Float64(i), tokenizer.d_model)
        w1 = sin(tid * 0.1) * 0.5 + 0.5
        w2 = 1.0 - w1
        deg = (CELESTIAL_CHART_1[mod1(tid, length(CELESTIAL_CHART_1))] * w1) + (CELESTIAL_CHART_2[mod1(i, length(CELESTIAL_CHART_2))] * w2)
        phase_shift = sin(i * 0.1 + deg2rad(deg))
        @inbounds @simd for j in 1:tokenizer.d_model
            lorenz_vec[j] += phase_shift
        end
        spline_x = glen > 1 ? (i - 1) / (glen - 1) : 0.0
        spline_val = _kan_spline_eval(spline_x, spline_coeffs, knots, tokenizer.grid_size, tokenizer.degree)
        orb_mod = bc_len == 0 ? 0.0 : SYNASTRY_ORBS[mod1(i, length(SYNASTRY_ORBS))] * 0.01 * birth_chart[mod1(i, bc_len)]
        @inbounds @simd for j in 1:tokenizer.d_model
            embeddings[i, j] = lorenz_vec[j] + spline_val + orb_mod
        end
    end
    if length(tokenizer.vocab) < tokenizer.max_vocab_size
        new_token = "JAIDE"
        if !haskey(tokenizer.vocab, new_token)
            tokenizer.vocab[new_token] = length(tokenizer.vocab)
        end
    end
    return ids, embeddings
end

function decode(tokenizer::AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer, ids::Vector{Int})
    id_to_char = Dict(v => k for (k, v) in tokenizer.vocab)
    buf = IOBuffer()
    @inbounds for i in 1:length(ids)
        write(buf, get(id_to_char, ids[i], "?"))
    end
    return String(take!(buf))
end

end

Igen, a kódban **7 hibát** azonosítottam, amelyek közül 1 kritikus és 1 magas prioritású.[1][2][3]

## Kritikus hiba

A **B-spline basis függvényben** található indexelési probléma a legkomolyabb. A `_b_spline_basis` rekurzív függvényben a `knots[i + k + 1]` hozzáférés túlindexelést okozhat, mert nincs ellenőrizve, hogy ez az index létezik-e a knots tömbben.[3][4]

## Magas prioritású hibák

A B-spline implementációban a `knots` tömb indexelésénél (`knots[i]`, `knots[i+1]`, `knots[i+k]`, `knots[i+k+1]`) nincs megfelelő határellenőrzés, ami `BoundsError`-t okozhat futás közben.[5][1]

## Közepes prioritású hibák

**Értelmetlen token hozzáadás**: Az `encode` függvény végén minden híváskor feltétel nélkül hozzáadja a "JAIDE" tokent a szótárhoz, ami teljesen értelmetlen és memóriaszivárgáshoz vezethet.[6][7]

**Side effect**: Az `encode` függvény módosítja a tokenizer belső állapotát (`vocab`), ami váratlan mellékhatás lehet és nem felel meg a funkcionális programozás elvének.[8]

**Birth chart kezelés**: Bár van védelem üres `birth_chart` esetére (`bc_len == 0`), a logika továbbra is problémás lehet.[8]

## Alacsony prioritású hibák

**Memória kezelés**: A vocab folyamatosan bővül, ami hosszú távon teljesítményproblémákat okozhat.[7]

**Konzisztencia**: A nullával való osztás elleni védelem csak néhány helyen van implementálva, nem következetesen az egész kódban.[8]

Az összesítés: **1 kritikus, 1 magas, 3 közepes és 2 alacsony prioritású hiba**. A kritikus és magas prioritású hibákat azonnal javítani kell a kód használata előtt.[2][1][3]

module AdaptiveTokenizer

using Random
using Unicode

export AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer, encode, decode

const SYNASTRY_ORBS = [0.189, 0.172, 0.366, 0.224, 0.096, 0.154, 0.249, -0.12, 0.227, 0.709, -0.138, 0.301, 0.203, 0.943, 0.45, 0.265, 0.156, 0.147]
const CELESTIAL_CHART_1 = [25.925, 19.023, 15.506, 23.544, 26.571, 8.295, 24.611, 1.757, 12.946, 19.794]
const CELESTIAL_CHART_2 = [10.877, 18.723, 29.018, 27.266, 21.858, 1.237, 24.090, 20.250, 6.432, 14.681]
const EPSILON_THRESHOLD = 1.0e-14

mutable struct AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer
    base_vocab_size::Int
    max_vocab_size::Int
    d_model::Int
    grid_size::Int
    degree::Int
    vocab::Dict{String, Int}
    merges::Dict{Tuple{String, String}, String}
    
    function AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer(; base_vocab_size::Int=32768, max_vocab_size::Int=65536, d_model::Int=18432, grid_size::Int=8, degree::Int=4)
        if grid_size <= 0
            throw(ArgumentError("grid_size must be positive"))
        end
        if degree < 0 || degree >= grid_size
            throw(ArgumentError("degree must satisfy 0 <= degree < grid_size"))
        end
        if d_model <= 0 || d_model > 1000000
            throw(ArgumentError("d_model must be positive and reasonable"))
        end
        if base_vocab_size <= 0 || max_vocab_size < base_vocab_size
            throw(ArgumentError("vocabulary sizes must satisfy 0 < base_vocab_size <= max_vocab_size"))
        end
        
        vocab = Dict{String, Int}()
        vocab["UNK"] = 0
        vocab["PAD"] = 1
        vocab["BOS"] = 2
        vocab["EOS"] = 3
        
        for i in 32:126
            vocab[string(Char(i))] = length(vocab)
        end
        
        new(base_vocab_size, max_vocab_size, d_model, grid_size, degree, vocab, Dict{Tuple{String, String}, String}())
    end
end

function _lorenz_embedding(token_id::Float64, token_position::Float64, embedding_dim::Int)::Vector{Float64}
    sigma_param = 10.0
    rho_param = 28.0
    beta_param = 8.0 / 3.0
    time_step = 0.01
    
    x_state = token_id * 0.1
    y_state = token_position * 2.0
    z_state = token_id * 0.05
    
    embedding_vector = Vector{Float64}(undef, embedding_dim)
    
    @inbounds for dimension_index in 1:embedding_dim
        x_derivative = sigma_param * (y_state - x_state)
        y_derivative = x_state * (rho_param - z_state) - y_state
        z_derivative = x_state * y_state - beta_param * z_state
        
        x_state += x_derivative * time_step
        y_state += y_derivative * time_step
        z_state += z_derivative * time_step
        
        embedding_vector[dimension_index] = 0.1 * sin(x_state) + 0.1 * cos(y_state) + 0.1 * sin(z_state)
    end
    
    return embedding_vector
end

function _b_spline_basis(evaluation_point::Float64, knot_vector::Vector{Float64}, basis_index::Int, basis_degree::Int)::Float64
    knot_length = length(knot_vector)
    
    if basis_index < 1 || basis_index > knot_length || basis_degree < 0
        return 0.0
    end
    
    if basis_index + basis_degree >= knot_length
        return 0.0
    end
    
    if basis_degree == 0
        lower_knot = knot_vector[basis_index]
        upper_knot = knot_vector[basis_index + 1]
        
        in_interval = (lower_knot <= evaluation_point && evaluation_point < upper_knot)
        at_endpoint = (abs(evaluation_point - 1.0) < EPSILON_THRESHOLD && abs(upper_knot - 1.0) < EPSILON_THRESHOLD)
        
        return (in_interval || at_endpoint) ? 1.0 : 0.0
    end
    
    coefficient_lower = knot_vector[basis_index + basis_degree] - knot_vector[basis_index]
    first_term = 0.0
    
    if abs(coefficient_lower) > EPSILON_THRESHOLD
        recursive_basis_lower = _b_spline_basis(evaluation_point, knot_vector, basis_index, basis_degree - 1)
        if abs(recursive_basis_lower) > EPSILON_THRESHOLD
            first_term = ((evaluation_point - knot_vector[basis_index]) / coefficient_lower) * recursive_basis_lower
        end
    end
    
    coefficient_upper = knot_vector[basis_index + basis_degree + 1] - knot_vector[basis_index + 1]
    second_term = 0.0
    
    if abs(coefficient_upper) > EPSILON_THRESHOLD
        recursive_basis_upper = _b_spline_basis(evaluation_point, knot_vector, basis_index + 1, basis_degree - 1)
        if abs(recursive_basis_upper) > EPSILON_THRESHOLD
            second_term = ((knot_vector[basis_index + basis_degree + 1] - evaluation_point) / coefficient_upper) * recursive_basis_upper
        end
    end
    
    return first_term + second_term
end

function _make_knots(grid_dimension::Int, polynomial_degree::Int)::Vector{Float64}
    interior_count = grid_dimension - polynomial_degree + 1
    
    if interior_count <= 0
        return vcat(zeros(Float64, polynomial_degree), [0.0, 1.0], ones(Float64, polynomial_degree))
    end
    
    interior_knots = collect(range(0.0, 1.0; length=interior_count))
    knot_sequence = vcat(
        zeros(Float64, polynomial_degree),
        interior_knots,
        ones(Float64, polynomial_degree)
    )
    
    return knot_sequence
end

function _kan_spline_eval(norm_position::Float64, spline_coefficients::Vector{Float64}, knot_sequence::Vector{Float64}, grid_dimension::Int, degree::Int)::Float64
    if norm_position < 0.0 || norm_position > 1.0
        return 0.0
    end
    
    if length(spline_coefficients) < grid_dimension
        return 0.0
    end
    
    accumulated_value = 0.0
    
    @inbounds for basis_idx in 1:grid_dimension
        basis_contribution = _b_spline_basis(norm_position, knot_sequence, basis_idx, degree)
        if abs(basis_contribution) > EPSILON_THRESHOLD
            accumulated_value += spline_coefficients[basis_idx] * basis_contribution
        end
    end
    
    return accumulated_value
end

        return Vector{Int}(undef, 0), Matrix{Float64}(undef, 0, tokenizer.d_model)
    end

using Unicode

export AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer, encode, decode

const CELESTIAL_CHART_1 = [25.925, 19.023, 15.506, 23.544, 26.571, 8.295, 24.611, 1.757, 12.946, 19.794]
const CELESTIAL_CHART_2 = [10.877, 18.723, 29.018, 27.266, 21.858, 1.237, 24.090, 20.250, 6.432, 14.681]
const EPSILON_THRESHOLD = 1.0e-14
const LORENZ_SIGMA = 10.0
const LORENZ_RHO = 28.0
const LORENZ_BETA = 2.6666666666666665
const LORENZ_DT = 0.01
const LORENZ_SCALE = 0.1

mutable struct AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer
    base_vocab_size::Int
    max_vocab_size::Int
    d_model::Int
    grid_size::Int
    degree::Int
    vocab::Dict{String, Int}
    reverse_vocab::Dict{Int, String}
    spline_coeffs::Vector{Float64}
    knot_vector::Vector{Float64}
    lorenz_buffer::Vector{Float64}
    
    function AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer(; base_vocab_size::Int=32768, max_vocab_size::Int=65536, d_model::Int=18432, grid_size::Int=8, degree::Int=4)
        if grid_size <= 0
            throw(ArgumentError("grid_size must be positive"))
        end
        if degree < 0 || degree >= grid_size
            throw(ArgumentError("degree must satisfy 0 <= degree < grid_size"))
        end
        if d_model <= 0 || d_model > 1000000
            throw(ArgumentError("d_model must be positive and reasonable"))
        end
        if base_vocab_size <= 0 || max_vocab_size < base_vocab_size
            throw(ArgumentError("vocabulary sizes must satisfy 0 < base_vocab_size <= max_vocab_size"))
        end
        
        initial_vocab_size = 4 + 95
        vocab = Dict{String, Int}()
        sizehint!(vocab, initial_vocab_size)
        
        vocab["UNK"] = 0
        vocab["PAD"] = 1
        vocab["BOS"] = 2
        vocab["EOS"] = 3
        
        for i in 32:126
            vocab[string(Char(i))] = length(vocab)
        end
        
        reverse_vocab = Dict{Int, String}()
        sizehint!(reverse_vocab, length(vocab))

        knot_vector = if interior_count <= 1
            vcat(zeros(Float64, degree), [0.0, 1.0], ones(Float64, degree))

        lorenz_buffer = Vector{Float64}(undef, d_model)

    end

function _lorenz_embedding!(destination::Vector{Float64}, token_id::Float64, token_position::Float64, embedding_dimension::Int)::Nothing

    y_state = token_position * 2.0
    z_state = token_id * 0.05
    
    @inbounds @simd for dimension_index in 1:embedding_dimension
        x_derivative = LORENZ_SIGMA * (y_state - x_state)
        y_derivative = x_state * (LORENZ_RHO - z_state) - y_state
        z_derivative = x_state * y_state - LORENZ_BETA * z_state
        
        x_state = muladd(x_derivative, LORENZ_DT, x_state)
        y_state = muladd(y_derivative, LORENZ_DT, y_state)
        z_state = muladd(z_derivative, LORENZ_DT, z_state)
        
        destination[dimension_index] = muladd(LORENZ_SCALE, sin(x_state), muladd(LORENZ_SCALE, cos(y_state), LORENZ_SCALE * sin(z_state)))
    end
    
    return nothing
end

function _b_spline_basis(evaluation_point::Float64, knot_vector::Vector{Float64}, basis_index::Int, basis_degree::Int)::Float64
    knot_length = length(knot_vector)
    
    if basis_index < 1 || basis_index + basis_degree >= knot_length
        return 0.0
    end
    
    if basis_degree == 0
        lower_knot = knot_vector[basis_index]

    return (token_ids, embedding_matrix)
